pluto.conjunction: A generational signature rather than a personal one: your whole cohort was born into a deep reshaping of what people believe.
pluto.harmonious: You share with your generation an ability to let old certainties go without panicking, and it shows in what you are willing to imagine.
pluto.square: Your ideals and your appetite for control undermine each other, and you have been at your most dangerous when most sincere.
pluto.opposition: You have watched belief and power set against each other all your life, and neither side has ever fully convinced you.

ascendant.conjunction: People cannot quite place you and tend to see what they want to; your presence is atmospheric rather than definite.
ascendant.harmonious: You are gentle to be around and people relax near you, and you have never had to work at either.
ascendant.square: Your manner is hard to read, so you are misunderstood at a first meeting far more often than you realise.
ascendant.opposition: You attract people who need saving and people who claim to be saving you, and both have been hard to see clearly at the time.

midheaven.conjunction: Your vocation is more calling than career, and what you are known for has never been entirely under your control.
midheaven.harmonious: You can make a living from imagination or from caring for people, and your reputation is warmer than your record on paper.
midheaven.square: Your career direction stays fogged for years, and the jobs you took were the ones you could not clearly explain.
midheaven.opposition: What people believe about you and what you privately are have never matched, and you have let the gap stand.
